Q5910.reason: A recorded general plan restricting building on a strip is most likely construed as an equitable servitude, though negative easement is a close alternative.

Q5623.reason: The commentary concerned a newsworthy public event and a public figure, so the broadcast was likely privileged and the professor loses.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest in the sister's children who reach 25 can vest too remotely, because the class stays open and a later-born child could reach 25 more than 21 years after all lives in being. That violates the Rule Against Perpetuities, so the gift is void and the friend holds the lot alone.
